title: Locant capture
description: One capture: the element the user pointed at, the cropped image on disk, and the context it came from. This file is the only interface between the Locant app and anything else. The Markdown on the clipboard is derived from it, never the other way around. Field names are platform-neutral.

id.description: Local timestamp yyyyMMdd-HHmmss plus 4 random base36 characters, so two captures in one second never collide. Same id as in the PNG and JSON file names. "Latest" is the newest createdAt, ties broken by id.

createdAt.description: ISO 8601 with the local UTC offset.

mode.description: fix: the user's own code is on screen, inferred from My Apps, the Simulator, a localhost URL, a bundle built in this machine's Xcode projects, or the user's own signing Team ID. reference: anything else. Affects payload wording and order only.

element.description: null when resolution failed. Never fabricated.

note.description: The user's note. Empty string when the note was skipped.

resolved.description: Always false when written by the app. Reserved for an agent or the MCP server to mark the capture as acted on.

ocr.description: Text recognized in the image, lines joined by newlines. Filled when the payload is vague: no element identifier anywhere. null otherwise.

iterations.description: Verify records (v0.4), newest last. Always empty when written by the v0.1 app.

elements.description: Region captures: every element at least 50 percent inside the drawn frame, reading order, at most 12.

nearby.description: Null-element point captures: the nearest labeled or identified elements around the click point.

targets.description: Present when more than one element was selected with Shift (v0.8): every element in the order it was added. The first is also `element`, so readers of one element keep working. Elements may come from different apps.

path.description: Absolute path to the cropped PNG.

scale.description: Backing scale factor of the source display (2 on Retina). Pixel size is points times scale.

crop.description: The crop rectangle in global screen points: element plus padding for point captures, the drawn frame for region captures.

app.description: The frontmost app at hotkey time.

window.description: The front window at hotkey time. null when there is none.

url.description: The page address when the element is a web node: read from the web area above it in Safari, Chromium browsers, and Electron apps. null otherwise. A localhost address puts the capture in fix mode.

simulator.description: Present only when the front app is the iOS Simulator.

projectRoot.description: Absolute path of the project directory that produced the app, when Locant could infer it (DerivedData, an ancestor with .xcodeproj/.xcworkspace/Package.swift). Absent otherwise; never guessed.

gitCommit.description: HEAD of the project at capture time, when projectRoot is a git repository. Absent otherwise.

rawRole.description: The platform's own role string (for example AXButton). Always present.

identifier.description: Developer-facing identifier as exposed by the platform, unmodified.

identifierSource.description: possiblySymbolName: role is image and the identifier matches ^[a-z0-9]+(\.[a-z0-9]+)*$ (SF Symbol naming), so it may not be a declared identifier. declared: any other non-empty identifier. unknown: identifier is empty.

path.description: Ancestry, root-first: at most the nearest 6 ancestors, ending with the element itself.

members.description: Present only when role is cluster: the accessibility elements the computed grouping contains, in reading order.

id.description: The element's id attribute, unmodified. null when it has none.

classes.description: The element's class list in source order. Empty when it has none.

parent.description: For a node with no id and no class of its own (a text node): the nearest element one or two steps above it that has one, which is what the markup names. Absent otherwise.

role.description: The parent's role, as in path.

id.description: The parent's id attribute. null or absent when it has none.

classes.description: The parent's class list in source order.

dom.description: Present only for a node of a web page or an Electron app (v0.8): the DOM's own handles, as WebKit and Chromium publish them through accessibility. An agent greps for the id first, then the classes.

framework.description: The page framework that answered, e.g. react.

name.description: The nearest component that rendered the element.

ancestors.description: The components above name, nearest first.

renderedAt.description: Where the component named by name is used.

component.description: Present only for a web node on a local page that answered a script Locant ran in it (a React development build in Chrome, Edge, Brave or Dia): the component that rendered the element and where its code is.

kind.description: only: the element's strings are string literals in exactly one file. likeliest: in several files, and the first place's file also holds other text from the capture. several: in several files, and nothing in the capture tells them apart. beside: the element's own strings are in no file, but fixed text in or beside it is. none: Locant looked and nothing matched.

strings.description: The strings that were found: the element's identifier or label (or the parts of a merged label, or the catalog key of a translation) for only, likeliest and several; a web node's id and classes; the neighbors' text for beside. For none, the strings looked for.

file.description: Path relative to source.projectRoot; absolute for a web node, whose capture has no projectRoot.

lines.description: Up to three 1-based lines where the string sits.

fileCount.description: How many files matched in all; more than places holds when the list was cut.

alsoThere.description: likeliest only: the other text from the capture found in the first place's file.

strings.description: Up to three of the strings around the element that the file holds.

file.description: Path relative to source.projectRoot; absolute for a web node, whose capture has no projectRoot.

lines.description: Up to three 1-based lines where the string sits.

around.description: A file that holds two or more of the strings around the element and none of its own, and more of them than the first place does: often the view that draws a row whose words are defined elsewhere (a menu filled from an enum).

shown.description: The text that was on screen.

key.description: The key the code uses for it; one of strings.

table.description: The string catalog that maps one to the other, e.g. Localizable.xcstrings.

localized.description: The entries of strings that were found through a string catalog (.xcstrings or .strings): the screen showed a translation, the code holds the key.

together.description: true when strings are a web node's classes and every line listed holds all of them at once: a list of utility classes found where it is written out. Absent otherwise.

sourceHint.description: Present only in a fix capture, when Locant finished reading the project's source while the note was typed (specs/source-hints.md): for a native element, the folder at source.projectRoot; for a web node the page did not locate (no component.source), the folder its localhost dev server runs in. Where the element's own strings sit: a native identifier or label as a whole string literal, a web node's id and rare classes as whole words. A hint, not proof: a string built at run time or read from data is not found.

index.description: 1-based: top to bottom in a column, left to right in a row.

count.description: How many siblings line up with the element, itself included.

axis.description: column: the siblings share its left edge and width. row: they share its top edge and height.

row.description: Present for a single pointed-at element with siblings of the same role that line up with it (specs/source-hints.md R167). Its place among them as drawn on screen when captured; a list that sorts or scrolls moves it, so it is not the item's place in the data.

role.description: Lowercase, platform-neutral role: button, textField, staticText, image, group, toolbar, navigationBar, unknown, and so on. Never AX-prefixed. `cluster` is computed by Locant where the platform exposes no container; it is not an accessibility element and carries `members`. rawRole LocantShape: a shape found on screen from its visible edges (a pill, capsule, card, or sheet), its frame those edges. rawRole LocantCluster: a grouping of neighboring elements, its frame approximate. rawRole LocantGroup: controls in one row or column lined up with small gaps, its frame their union. rawRole LocantText: a line of text Locant read from the screen inside an element that merges it (Device Hub).

frame.description: Global screen points, top-left origin (accessibility convention).

dom.description: A web node's DOM handle when it has no accessibility identifier: #id, else .firstClass (v0.8). Absent otherwise.

imagePath.description: Absolute path to the after-image PNG.

gitBefore.description: Commit SHA before the change, when the app maps to a repository.

diffStat.description: Output of git diff --stat between gitBefore and gitAfter, or of the working tree against HEAD when they are equal.

frame.description: Where the element was found for this iteration, global screen points.

app.description: The app that owns this element.

url.description: The page address when this element is a web node.

imagePath.description: Absolute path to this element's own crop, present only when the set did not fit the capture's one image (another display, or more than 60 percent of it).

file.description: An absolute path on this Mac when Locant found the file, else the path the dev server serves it under.
